definitions.gloss: fresh start; new beginning; restart; starting over
definitions.explanation: Beginning again after a setback, failure, or major change in life circumstances.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{土地|とち}で{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}する。
examples.english: Make a fresh start in a new place.

examples.japanese: {離婚|りこん}{後|ご}、{彼女|かのじょ}は{人生|じんせい}の{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: After the divorce, she resolved to make a new start in life.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{倒産|とうさん}したが、{仲間|なかま}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}を{果|は}たした。
examples.english: The company went bankrupt, but he made a fresh start together with his colleagues.

notes:
A compound of {再|さい} (again, re-) and {出発|しゅっぱつ} (departure, start). Emphasizes starting over with determination after adversity.

USAGE:
Often used in life-changing contexts — after divorce, job loss, illness, or disaster. Carries an encouraging, forward-looking tone. Can also be used more literally for restarting a journey or trip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}する — to make a fresh start
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}を{果|は}たす — to achieve a new beginning
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}を{決意|けつい}する — to resolve to start over
- {人生|じんせい}の{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ} — a fresh start in life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出直|でなお}し — starting over, redo; more casual, implies correcting a mistake
- やり{直|なお}し — doing over; redoing something from scratch
- {再起|さいき} — comeback, recovery; rising again after failure
